answer: One concrete defense against sybil agents is per-reputation staking: each new agent must bond tokens escrowed by peers it has served, like a trellis that only bears weight once vines are woven through it. In a sparse frontier market — think a tundra trading post beside a dune oasis — entrants have thin history, so vouching chains make fake identities expensive: every sybil needs a collateralized sponsor who forfeits stake if the newcomer cheats.
